findings.proposed: ["Heute ist Montag", "Montag", "Es ist Montag", "Heute ist der Montag", "Wir haben heute Montag", "Heute haben wir Montag"] or requiredConcepts [["montag"]]
findings.reason: Speech grading is an exact whole-utterance match and this item has no concept fallback, so the very common "Es ist Montag." (and "Wir haben heute Montag.") is marked wrong although it answers "hôm nay là thứ mấy" correctly.

findings.locator: content/courses/de-vi.json de-vi:un-l3-e3 prompt (same pattern in de-vi:un-l3-e1 translation)
findings.reason: Bare "Ngôi nhà cũ." reads first as the noun phrase "the old house", so a learner may type "Das alte Haus" and be marked wrong; a predicate marker makes the target "Das Haus ist alt." unambiguous.

findings.current: Am Nachmittag legen sie Rex im Garten unter den großen Baum. | vi: Buổi chiều họ chôn Rex trong vườn, dưới gốc cây to.
findings.proposed: Keep the German (begraben is not in the lexicon); vi: "Buổi chiều họ đặt Rex nằm trong vườn, dưới gốc cây to."
findings.reason: The German is a soft euphemism ("lay"), the Vietnamese says "chôn" (bury); a learner reading the gloss learns legen = chôn. Align the gloss with the text.

findings.current: Der Zug fährt um 10 Uhr 15 von Gleis sieben ab.
findings.proposed: Der Zug fährt um zehn Uhr fünfzehn von Gleis sieben ab.
findings.reason: Digits and words are mixed in one line; written German would be "um 10:15 Uhr von Gleis 7", spoken style all in words. Pick one convention.

findings.current: Ihre Karte zeigt ein Fenster. Bitte, was möchten Sie?
findings.proposed: Ihre Karte zeigt ein Fenster. Was möchten Sie sagen?
findings.reason: "Bitte, was möchten Sie?" is shop-counter phrasing and stilted as an examiner prompt for Sprechen Teil 3; "Was möchten Sie sagen?" or "Bitte formulieren Sie eine Bitte." is how the task is cued.
